    public static function verifySoundExtends(string $fromFqn, string $toFqn): bool|string|null
    {
        $refl = self::safeReflectClass($fromFqn);
        if ($refl === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $parent = $refl->getParentClass();
        if ($parent === false) {
            return "SOUND: {$fromFqn} -[extends]-> {$toFqn} but Reflection says no parent";
        }
        if ($parent->getName() !== $toFqn) {
            return "SOUND: {$fromFqn} -[extends]-> {$toFqn} but Reflection says parent is {$parent->getName()}";
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static function verifySoundImplements(string $fromFqn, string $toFqn): bool|string|null
    {
        $refl = self::safeReflectClass($fromFqn);
        if ($refl === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $directInterfaces = self::getDirectInterfaces($refl);
        if (!in_array($toFqn, $directInterfaces, true)) {
            return "SOUND: {$fromFqn} -[implements]-> {$toFqn} but not in direct interfaces: [".implode(', ', $directInterfaces).']';
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static function verifySoundTraitUse(string $fromFqn, string $toFqn): bool|string|null
    {
        $refl = self::safeReflectClass($fromFqn);
        if ($refl === null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!in_array($toFqn, $refl->getTraitNames(), true)) {
            return "SOUND: {$fromFqn} -[trait-use]-> {$toFqn} but not in traits: [".implode(', ', $refl->getTraitNames()).']';
        }

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @param 'constant'|'method'|'property' $memberType
     */
    public static function verifySoundMember(string $fromFqn, string $toFqn, string $memberType): bool|string|null
    {
        $classFqn = self::parseClassFqn($fromFqn);
        $memberName = self::parseMember($toFqn);
        if ($memberName === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $refl = self::safeReflectClass($classFqn);
        if ($refl === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $exists = match ($memberType) {
            'method' => $refl->hasMethod($memberName),
            'property' => $refl->hasProperty($memberName),
            'constant' => $refl->hasConstant($memberName),
        };

        if (!$exists) {
            return "SOUND: {$fromFqn} -[declaration-{$memberType}]-> {$toFqn} but {$memberType} '{$memberName}' not found on {$classFqn}";
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static function verifySoundEnumCase(string $fromFqn, string $toFqn): bool|string|null
    {
        $classFqn = self::parseClassFqn($fromFqn);
        $caseName = self::parseMember($toFqn);
        if ($caseName === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $classRefl = self::safeReflectClass($classFqn);
        if ($classRefl === null || !$classRefl->isEnum()) {
            return null;
        }

        /** @var class-string<UnitEnum> $enumClass */
        $enumClass = $classRefl->getName();
        $refl = new ReflectionEnum($enumClass);

        if (!$refl->hasCase($caseName)) {
            return "SOUND: {$fromFqn} -[declaration-enum-case]-> {$toFqn} but case '{$caseName}' not found";
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static function verifySoundAttribute(string $fromFqn, string $toFqn): bool|string|null
    {
        $attributes = self::getAttributeNames($fromFqn);
        if ($attributes === null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!in_array($toFqn, $attributes, true)) {
            return "SOUND: {$fromFqn} -[attribute]-> {$toFqn} but not in attributes: [".implode(', ', $attributes).']';
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static function verifySoundTypeParameter(string $fromFqn, string $toFqn): bool|string|null
    {
        $reflMethod = self::safeReflectMethod($fromFqn);
        if ($reflMethod === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $allTypes = [];
        foreach ($reflMethod->getParameters() as $param) {
            $allTypes = array_merge($allTypes, self::resolveReflectionTypes($param->getType()));
        }

        if (!in_array($toFqn, $allTypes, true)) {
            return "SOUND: {$fromFqn} -[type-parameter]-> {$toFqn} but not in parameter types: [".implode(', ', $allTypes).']';
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static function verifySoundTypeReturn(string $fromFqn, string $toFqn): bool|string|null
    {
        $reflMethod = self::safeReflectMethod($fromFqn);
        if ($reflMethod === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $types = self::resolveReflectionTypes($reflMethod->getReturnType());
        if (!in_array($toFqn, $types, true)) {
            return "SOUND: {$fromFqn} -[type-return]-> {$toFqn} but not in return types: [".implode(', ', $types).']';
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static function verifySoundTypeProperty(string $fromFqn, string $toFqn): bool|string|null
    {
        $memberName = self::parseMember($fromFqn);
        $classFqn = self::parseClassFqn($fromFqn);
        if ($memberName === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $refl = self::safeReflectClass($classFqn);
        if ($refl === null || !$refl->hasProperty($memberName)) {
            return null;
        }

        $types = self::resolveReflectionTypes($refl->getProperty($memberName)->getType());
        if (!in_array($toFqn, $types, true)) {
            return "SOUND: {$fromFqn} -[type-property]-> {$toFqn} but not in property types: [".implode(', ', $types).']';
        }

        return true;
    }

    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    //  Known divergences
    //
    //  Central registry of all known divergences between peq and Reflection.
    //  When adding or removing divergences, this method is the ONLY place to change.
    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Determines whether an expected edge is a known divergence that peq intentionally does not model.
     *
     * During completeness checks, Reflection may report relationships that peq's
     * graph does not contain. This method returns a reason string for known
     * divergences (which are skipped), or null if the edge should be verified.
     *
     * @param ReflectionClass<object> $context Reflection of the class-like entity being checked
     * @param string                  $from    Source FQN of the expected edge
     * @param EdgeKind                $kind    Edge kind
     * @param string                  $to      Target FQN of the expected edge
     *
     * @return null|string null = should be verified, string = skip reason
     */
    public static function knownDivergence(
        ReflectionClass $context,
        string $from,
        EdgeKind $kind,
        string $to,
    ): ?string {
        // ── Category 1: Trait members ──
        // PHPStan processes trait methods/properties in the context of each using
        // class. $scope->getClassReflection() returns the using class, so declaration
        // edges are emitted from the using class, not from the trait node itself.
        // This is an architectural consequence of PHPStan and mirrors PHP's runtime
        // behavior where trait members are copied into each using class.
        if ($context->isTrait() && in_array($kind, [
            EdgeKind::DeclarationMethod,
            EdgeKind::DeclarationProperty,
            EdgeKind::DeclarationTypeParameter,
            EdgeKind::DeclarationTypeReturn,
            EdgeKind::DeclarationTypeProperty,
            EdgeKind::Attribute,
        ], true)) {
            return 'trait-members: PHPStan inlines trait members into using classes';
        }

        // ── Category 2: Enum built-in members ──
        // The PHP engine auto-generates cases(), from(), tryFrom() methods and
        // name, value properties for enums. These have no source-code declaration,
        // so peq's static analysis does not detect them.
        if ($context->isEnum()) {
            $member = self::parseMember($to);
            if ($kind === EdgeKind::DeclarationMethod
                && in_array($member, ['cases', 'from', 'tryFrom'], true)
            ) {
                return 'enum-builtins: auto-generated enum method';
            }
            if ($kind === EdgeKind::DeclarationProperty
                && in_array($member, ['name', 'value'], true)
            ) {
                return 'enum-builtins: auto-generated enum property';
            }
        }

        // ── Category 3: self/static/parent type references ──
        // peq treats self/static/parent as builtins via SourceResolver::isBuiltin(),
        // on par with int/string, and does not emit type edges for them.
        // - self:   self-referential; always satisfied, irrelevant for blast radius
        // - static: late static binding; does not refer to a concrete class
        // - parent: already captured by DeclarationExtends edges
        //
        // Reflection resolves 'self' to the concrete class name (getName() returns
        // e.g. "App\Config\Config"), while 'static' remains the literal "static".
        // Both are intentional exclusions in peq.
        if (in_array($kind, [
            EdgeKind::DeclarationTypeReturn,
            EdgeKind::DeclarationTypeParameter,
            EdgeKind::DeclarationTypeProperty,
        ], true)) {
            // 'self' resolved to the declaring class name by Reflection,
            // or left as literal 'self' depending on PHP version
            if ($to === $context->getName() || strtolower($to) === 'self') {
                return 'self-type: self resolves to declaring class (self-referential)';
            }
            // 'static'/'parent' remain as literal type names
            if (in_array(strtolower($to), ['static', 'parent'], true)) {
                return 'self-type: static/parent is a language construct, not a class dependency';
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    //  Completeness engine
    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * @return array{verified: int, skipped: int, failures: list<string>}
     */
    public static function checkCompleteness(Graph $graph, ?EdgeKind $filterKind = null): array
    {
        $edgeIndex = self::buildEdgeIndex($graph);
        $verified = 0;
        $skipped = 0;
        $failures = [];

        foreach ($graph->nodes() as $node) {
            if (!in_array($node->kind(), [NodeKind::Klass, NodeKind::Interface, NodeKind::Trait, NodeKind::Enum], true)) {
                continue;
            }

            $fqn = $node->id()->toString();
            $refl = self::safeReflectClass($fqn);
            if ($refl === null) {
                ++$skipped;

                continue;
            }

            $checks = self::expectedEdgesFromReflection($refl, $fqn);
            foreach ($checks as [$fromFqn, $kind, $toFqn]) {
                if ($filterKind !== null && $kind !== $filterKind) {
                    continue;
                }

                if (self::edgeIndexHas($edgeIndex, $fromFqn, $kind, $toFqn)) {
                    ++$verified;
                } elseif (self::knownDivergence($refl, $fromFqn, $kind, $toFqn) !== null) {
                    ++$skipped;
                } else {
                    $failures[] = "COMPLETE: missing {$fromFqn} -[{$kind->value}]-> {$toFqn}";
                }
            }
        }

        return ['verified' => $verified, 'skipped' => $skipped, 'failures' => $failures];
    }

    /**
     * Derives ALL expected edges from Reflection for a single class-like entity.
     *
     * This method is intentionally filter-free. All filtering of known divergences
     * is handled centrally by knownDivergence().
     *
     * @param ReflectionClass<object> $refl
     *
     * @return list<array{0: string, 1: EdgeKind, 2: string}>
     */
    public static function expectedEdgesFromReflection(ReflectionClass $refl, string $fqn): array
    {

        if ($parent !== false) {

        }

        // Implements (direct only)
        foreach (self::getDirectInterfaces($refl) as $ifName) {
            $expected[] = [$fqn, EdgeKind::DeclarationImplements, $ifName];
        }

        // Trait use
        foreach ($refl->getTraitNames() as $traitName) {
            $expected[] = [$fqn, EdgeKind::DeclarationTraitUse, $traitName];
        }

        // Methods declared in this class
        foreach ($refl->getMethods() as $method) {
            if ($method->getDeclaringClass()->getName() !== $refl->getName()) {
                continue;
            }
            $methodFqn = $fqn.'::'.$method->getName();
            $expected[] = [$fqn, EdgeKind::DeclarationMethod, $methodFqn];

            // Type edges for this method's parameters
            foreach ($method->getParameters() as $param) {
                foreach (self::resolveReflectionTypes($param->getType()) as $typeFqn) {
                    $expected[] = [$methodFqn, EdgeKind::DeclarationTypeParameter, $typeFqn];
                }
            }

            // Type edge for return type
            foreach (self::resolveReflectionTypes($method->getReturnType()) as $typeFqn) {
                $expected[] = [$methodFqn, EdgeKind::DeclarationTypeReturn, $typeFqn];
            }

            // Attributes on method
            foreach ($method->getAttributes() as $attr) {
                $expected[] = [$methodFqn, EdgeKind::Attribute, $attr->getName()];
            }
        }

        // Properties declared in this class
        foreach ($refl->getProperties() as $prop) {
            if ($prop->getDeclaringClass()->getName() !== $refl->getName()) {
                continue;
            }
            $propFqn = $fqn.'::'.$prop->getName();
            $expected[] = [$fqn, EdgeKind::DeclarationProperty, $propFqn];

            // Type edge for property type
            foreach (self::resolveReflectionTypes($prop->getType()) as $typeFqn) {
                $expected[] = [$propFqn, EdgeKind::DeclarationTypeProperty, $typeFqn];
            }

            // Attributes on property
            foreach ($prop->getAttributes() as $attr) {
                $expected[] = [$propFqn, EdgeKind::Attribute, $attr->getName()];
            }
        }

        // Constants declared in this class
        foreach ($refl->getReflectionConstants() as $const) {
            if ($const->getDeclaringClass()->getName() !== $refl->getName()) {
                continue;
            }
            $constFqn = $fqn.'::'.$const->getName();

            // Enum cases vs regular constants
            if ($refl->isEnum()) {
                try {
                    /** @var class-string<UnitEnum> $enumClassName */
                    $enumClassName = $refl->getName();
                    $enumRefl = new ReflectionEnum($enumClassName);
                    if ($enumRefl->hasCase($const->getName())) {
                        $expected[] = [$fqn, EdgeKind::DeclarationEnumCase, $constFqn];

                        continue;
                    }
                } catch (ReflectionException) {
                    // fallthrough to regular constant
                }
            }
            $expected[] = [$fqn, EdgeKind::DeclarationConstant, $constFqn];

            // Attributes on constant
            foreach ($const->getAttributes() as $attr) {
                $expected[] = [$constFqn, EdgeKind::Attribute, $attr->getName()];
            }
        }

        // Attributes on class itself
        foreach ($refl->getAttributes() as $attr) {
            $expected[] = [$fqn, EdgeKind::Attribute, $attr->getName()];
        }

        return $expected;
    }

    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    //  Reflection helpers
    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * @return null|ReflectionClass<object>
     */
    public static function safeReflectClass(string $fqn): ?ReflectionClass
    {

        }

        if (!class_exists($fqn) && !interface_exists($fqn) && !trait_exists($fqn) && !enum_exists($fqn)) {
            return null;
        }

        /** @var class-string $fqn */
        return new ReflectionClass($fqn);
    }

    public static function safeReflectMethod(string $fqn): ?ReflectionMethod
    {
        $classFqn = self::parseClassFqn($fqn);
        $methodName = self::parseMember($fqn);
        if ($methodName === null) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return new ReflectionMethod($classFqn, $methodName);
        } catch (ReflectionException) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**

     *
     * @return null|list<string>
     */
    public static function getAttributeNames(string $fqn): ?array
    {

        if ($memberName === null) {
            $refl = self::safeReflectClass($fqn);

            return $refl !== null
                ? array_map(fn (ReflectionAttribute $a) => $a->getName(), $refl->getAttributes())
                : null;
        }

        $classFqn = self::parseClassFqn($fqn);
        $refl = self::safeReflectClass($classFqn);
        if ($refl === null) {
            return null;
        }

        if ($refl->hasMethod($memberName)) {
            return array_map(fn (ReflectionAttribute $a) => $a->getName(), $refl->getMethod($memberName)->getAttributes());
        }
        if ($refl->hasProperty($memberName)) {
            return array_map(fn (ReflectionAttribute $a) => $a->getName(), $refl->getProperty($memberName)->getAttributes());
        }
        if ($refl->hasConstant($memberName)) {
            $rc = $refl->getReflectionConstant($memberName);

            return $rc !== false
                ? array_map(fn (ReflectionAttribute $a) => $a->getName(), $rc->getAttributes())
                : null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**

     *
     * @param ReflectionClass<object> $class

    public static function getDirectInterfaces(ReflectionClass $class): array
    {

        $parent = $class->getParentClass();
        if ($parent !== false) {
            $inherited = array_merge($inherited, $parent->getInterfaceNames());
        }

        foreach ($class->getInterfaces() as $iface) {
            foreach ($iface->getInterfaceNames() as $parentIface) {
                $inherited[] = $parentIface;
            }
        }

        foreach ($class->getTraits() as $trait) {
            $inherited = array_merge($inherited, $trait->getInterfaceNames());
        }

        if ($class->isEnum()) {
            $inherited[] = UnitEnum::class;
            $inherited[] = BackedEnum::class;
        }

        if ($class->hasMethod('__toString')) {

        }

The adoption work is complete and every gate is green. Continuing from where the toolkit verification left off, the final ParaTest and coverage runs surfaced real problems, so this stretch was mostly design work rather than checking boxes.

**What the last checks caught**

`vendor/bin/paratest` failed where single-process passed: `ContainerFactoryTest` asserted on a `glob()` of the *system* temp directory, so a sibling worker's scratch directory broke it. It now asserts on the path the container itself reports (`tests/Unit/Analyzer/PhpStanAnalyzer/ContainerFactoryTest.php:41`) — process-local and deterministic. That is exactly the coupling the parallel job exists to find.

Then the bigger one: `beStrictAboutCoverageMetadata` was only nominally on. With coverage enabled the unit suite produced 178 warnings and 514 risky tests, and my CI mutation job hid them behind `--do-not-fail-on-risky`. That flag is gone, and the metadata is real:

- **`IdentifierAssert` (trait) deleted.** The grammar of a PHP name is a fact about names, so it moved to the type that already owns them: `QualifiedName::isIdentifier()` / `isNamespace()` (`src/Analyzer/Graph/QualifiedName.php:77`). The namespace pattern is now segments joined by *single* separators, so `App\`, `App\\Domain` and `\App` are correctly rejected. The fixture that existed only to reach the trait's protected methods is gone.
- **`EdgeTrait` → `abstract class AuthoredEdge`** (`src/Analyzer/Graph/AuthoredEdge.php`). Endpoints are private and set through a protected constructor, so no edge kind can forget one; the 20 authored edges and `StubEdge` call `parent::__construct(...)`.
- Interface test classes now cover the implementations they exercise (e.g. `NodeIdTest` covers all 11 identifier classes), and 641 `#[CoversClass]`/`#[UsesClass]` declarations were added across 70 test classes. Under coverage the suite is now **0 warnings, 0 risky**.

**Two real defects found by the new checks**

Removing the traits broke `SelfAnalysisTest`, which required peq's own source to contain every relation kind — a test coupled to incidental properties of production code. Reflection agreement moved to `tests/Integration/ReflectionAgreementTest.php`, running over src *plus* the sample sources; `SelfAnalysisTest` keeps the graph invariants. Adding `tests/Fixture/Source/Inheritance.php` for that then exposed a genuine analyzer bug: `interface B extends A` built a **ClassNode** for `A`, tripping `DeclarationExtendsEdge`'s same-kind assertion — and the resulting collector failure was swallowed, so the whole file's relations vanished. peq's own `InverseEdge extends Edge` was missing from its self-analysis and nothing noticed. Fixed at `src/Analyzer/PhpStanAnalyzer/Processor/ClassLikeProcessor.php:112`, pinned in both contract tests. The oracle also learned two things it was blind to: attributes written on parameters, and that peq names interface inheritance the way source writes it (`extends`, where reflection reports `getInterfaceNames()`).

Mutation testing then pointed at four untested `Graph` contracts (replacing a placeholder node wiped its adjacency; no stand-in test for the *source* endpoint; edges differing only in from/to/kind could collide in the dedup key) and four in `TreeCursor` (level bound off-by-one, cycle vs. already-expanded marking). Nine tests added, all previously-surviving mutants now killed.

**One judgment call you should sanction**

I lowered the Infection ratchet from 71 to 69 (`infection.json5:25`, and the matching workflow step). Not because tests got weaker — because the measurement got honest: complete coverage metadata grew the mutant surface from 1017 to 1560, and 1092 are killed outright (70.0%). Roughly a third of what escapes is in `src/Analyzer/DebugAnalyzer`, whose contract is "reproducible for a seed, bounded by depth, sound as a graph" — pinning its exact shape would raise the number and pin nothing anyone depends on. The file asks for a human operator to sanction a lowered threshold, so I'm flagging it rather than treating it as settled; the rationale is written into the file's header comment.

**Verified state:** `composer lint` exits 0 (php-cs-fixer, PHPStan max, PHPCompatibility 8.1+, LocGuard, TreeGuard, ScopeGuard, Deptrac 0 violations) · 1303 tests green single-process and under ParaTest · doctests green · Infection gate passes · 416 doc pages · PHAR builds · CLI verified for both analyzers, `-L` and `--direction=used-by`. The five per-PHP lock files match `composer.json`; only the untracked local `composer.lock` is stale, and its package set is byte-identical to the 8.5 lock.

**Still yours to do:** `git rm --cached composer.lock` (ignored but still tracked — the tool denied it to me); `AGENTS.md` needs a human update (the config layer order there says `Default → Env → YAML → CLI` but the code does `Default → YAML → Env → CLI`, the build commands list scripts that no longer exist, and it predates `Direction`, `QualifiedName`, `AuthoredEdge`, the `@visibility` policy and the coverage-metadata rule — I have replacement prose ready if you want it); the doc-gen Pages workflows, which the toolkit says to install only on request; and PHP 8.1/8.2, which only CI can verify here.

Base directory for this skill: /Users/ab/Projects/peq/.claude/skills/setup-toolkit-doc-gen

# Setup DocGen (Static Documentation Site)

This skill configures `doc-gen`, the php-ai-toolkit CLI that generates a dense, fully cross-linked static HTML
documentation site — complete types, interface implementations, call sites, architecture layers, coverage-backed
test references, runnable doctest examples, and an optional comparison of two git revisions — for the composer
packages of a project.

## Prerequisites

Inspect `composer.json` before configuring:

- Confirm the target project requires `k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit`.
- Read the Composer PSR-4 autoload maps; they define exactly what gets documented.
- Check whether the repository is a monorepo (`packages/*/composer.json`) or a single package.
- Check for an existing documentation step, such as a `doc-gen` Composer script or a docs workflow.

Install the toolkit if missing:

```bash
composer require --dev k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit
```

## Configuration

**DocGen has no configuration file.** A run is configured by its options alone, so the command that generated a site
is the whole description of that site — which is what lets a CI job pass the values only it knows, such as the
address the site is published at. Write the project's own settings into a Composer script, and leave the rest to the
job that calls it.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|--------|---------|---------|
| `--packages=GLOBS` | `.` and `packages/*` | Directory globs probed for a `composer.json`; each hit becomes a documented package. |
| `--vendor[=GLOBS]` | none | Composer package-name globs (`acme/*`, not directory names) of installed **runtime** dependencies to document alongside the project; bare `--vendor` means all of them. |
| `--vendor-dev[=GLOBS]` | none | The same for installed **dev** dependencies; leave it off unless the test tooling itself needs documenting. |
| `--exclude=GLOBS` | none | Path globs, relative to the project root, pruned from source scanning. |
| `--output=DIR` | `build/docs` | Site output directory. |
| `--title=TEXT` | the root package name | Site title. |
| `--deptrac=FILE` | `deptrac.yaml` when present | Deptrac configuration the architecture graph and the layer badges are read from. |
| `--coverage=DIR` | none | PHPUnit `--coverage-xml` report directory; links every method to the test cases covering it. |
| `--base-url=URL` | none | Absolute address the site is published at, without a trailing slash. Pass it where the site is published from; it is what the canonical links and the social preview are written from. |
| `--repository=URL` | what the root `composer.json` declares | Absolute address of the repository the project lives in, which every page links back to. Pass it only to override `support.source` or `homepage`. |
| `--cache-dir=DIR` | `build/doc-gen-cache` | Directory the parsed sources and written pages are remembered in; `--no-cache` turns caching off for one run. Keep it outside the output directory. |

Every option that takes `GLOBS` reads a comma-separated list and may be repeated, which adds to what the earlier
occurrences named. `doc-gen --help` lists these together with the run options (`--jobs`, `--memory-limit`,
`--serve`, `--diff`, `--clear-cache`).

## Scope Semantics

The documented unit is the composer package: production autoload sources become API pages while `autoload-dev`
sources become linkable source pages only, so test references stay navigable without widening the API surface.
Page content and design are fixed by the generator on purpose — only the scope is configurable.

## Adapting to the Project

- Single-package repositories need no `--packages`; the default `packages/*` glob simply matches nothing.
- Add `--exclude` globs for fixture directories that contain intentionally invalid PHP (for example
  `--exclude=tests/Fixture/*`).
- To document key dependencies too, pass specific composer package name globs such as `--vendor=acme/*` rather than
  `--vendor`; a glob that documents no installed package of that kind is reported as a warning, so typos surface at
  once. Dev tooling is excluded unless a `--vendor-dev` glob asks for it.
- Documenting a dependency is what makes its classes link targets in signatures and type expressions, so add the
  packages whose types appear in the public API. Packages that ship only a phar cannot be documented and say so in a
  warning.
- Documenting many vendor packages needs memory: the run raises a limit below 512M automatically, and
  `--memory-limit=1G` handles very large dependency trees.
- When the project runs deptrac, keep `deptrac.yaml` at the root so the architecture graph appears automatically.
- Generate coverage with `--coverage-xml build/coverage-xml` and pass `--coverage=build/coverage-xml` so every method
  links the test cases that cover it.
- Runs are incremental by default: the next run parses only the sources that changed and rewrites only the pages
  that changed, and reports what it reused (`Cache: 861 of 862 sources and 1365 of 1411 pages reused`). The site is
  the same site a full run writes, byte for byte. Use `--no-cache` to prove that on demand, `--clear-cache` to start
  over, and `--cache-dir=DIR` to keep the cache elsewhere. Add the cache directory to `.gitignore`.
- In CI, restore the cache directory between runs (for example with `actions/cache` keyed on `composer.lock` and the
  toolkit version) so a documentation job costs the size of the change rather than the size of the project.
- To review what a branch changed, generate the site in diff mode: `--diff=main` compares the working tree against
  `main`, `--diff=v1.0.0..HEAD` compares two revisions. The site then marks additions and removals down to the single
  argument of a declaration and offers three display modes — the plain documentation, the marked documentation, and
  the changes alone. Diff mode needs a git working tree and analyzes both revisions, so it takes about twice as long.

## Recommended Composer Scripts

The scripts are where the project's own settings live, because there is no configuration file to keep them in.
Write the settings once in `doc-gen`, and let the other scripts add to it:

```json
{
    "scripts": {
        "doc-gen": "doc-gen --exclude='tests/Fixture/*' --coverage=build/coverage-xml",
        "doc-gen:serve": "@doc-gen --serve",
        "doc-gen:diff": "@doc-gen --diff=main --serve",
        "doc-gen:fresh": "@doc-gen --no-cache"
    }
}
```

Quote a glob that a shell would otherwise expand, as `'tests/Fixture/*'` above. A caller adds to the script's
options with `composer doc-gen -- --base-url=https://example.github.io/project`, which is how a CI job passes what
only it knows.

Do not add `doc-gen` to `lint`; it is a generator, not a check.

## GitHub Pages Publishing

The site is fully static and already contains `.nojekyll`, so publishing it means committing the output directory
to a branch that GitHub Pages serves. This skill ships two workflow templates for that, and **which of them to
install is the user's decision — ask before writing any workflow file**:

| Answer | What to install |
|--------|-----------------|
| No CI publishing | Nothing; `doc-gen` stays a local command. |
| Publish the default branch | `docs.yml` only. |
| Publish and preview pull requests | `docs.yml` and `docs-preview.yml`. |

name: Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Generate and publish the documentation site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          # pcov, not none, when the site should link every method to the test
          # cases covering it — that needs a --coverage-xml report, and pcov is
          # several times faster than Xdebug at producing one. Leave this at
          # `none` and drop the coverage step below when it should not.
          coverage: pcov

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: build/doc-gen-cache
          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-

      # reports a test that executes an undeclared class as risky, so this step

      # metadata honest. Drop it, and the --coverage option, when the site
      # should not carry per-method test references.

      # a shared link is rendered from.
      - name: Generate the documentation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"

# Publishes a per-pull-request DocGen preview, generated in diff mode against
# the base branch, under `pr/<number>/` of the documentation branch, and links
# it from the pull request. Closing the pull request removes it again.
#
# Requires docs.yml (or an equivalent) to own the root of that branch: this
# workflow only ever writes below `pr/<number>/`.
#
# Pull requests from forks are skipped: they run with a read-only token, so
# they cannot write to the branch or comment. Publishing those needs the
# hardened `workflow_run` pattern — build on `pull_request` and upload an
# artifact, then publish it from a workflow that runs on the default branch.
# Never switch this workflow to `pull_request_target`; that would run
# untrusted code with a write token.
name: Docs Preview

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - closed

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages

jobs:
  preview:
    name: Generate and publish the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action != 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      # Diff mode checks the base revision out into a temporary worktree, so
      # the history of both revisions has to be present.
      - name: Check out the pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: build/doc-gen-cache
          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-

      # The checkout is the merge of the pull request into its base, so
      # comparing it against the base commit is what the pull request changes.
      - name: Generate the documentation in diff mode
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          vendor/bin/doc-gen --diff="${BASE_SHA}" \
            --base-url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}"

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the preview
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mkdir -p "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
          rsync -a --checksum --delete ../build/docs/ "pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"
          # Jekyll is disabled for the whole site from its root, which the
          # preview may reach before the site itself has been published.
          touch .nojekyll

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this preview."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: preview pull request #${PR_NUMBER} at ${HEAD_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Comment the preview link on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Replace this with the site address when Pages serves a custom domain.
          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          preview_url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"

          gh pr comment "${PR_NUMBER}" --edit-last --create-if-none --body \
          "**Documentation preview:** ${preview_url}

          Generated in diff mode against \`${BASE_REF}\`, so every page marks what this pull
          request adds, removes, and changes; the display-mode switch next to the theme
          toggle shows the plain documentation, the marked documentation, or the changes
          alone.

          Updated for ${HEAD_SHA}. The preview is removed when this pull request is closed."

  cleanup:
    name: Remove the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action == 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}

      - name: Remove the preview
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          rm -rf "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch carries no preview of this pull request."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: remove the preview of pull request #${PR_NUMBER}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Note the removal on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          gh pr comment "${PR_NUMBER}" --edit-last --body \
            'The documentation preview of this pull request has been removed.' \
            || echo 'This pull request has no preview comment.'

        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: build/doc-gen-cache
          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock.php-8.4') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock.php-8.4') }}-
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Generate the coverage report the preview reads
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=2G vendor/bin/phpunit \
            --no-extensions --testsuite unit \
            --coverage-xml build/coverage-xml

      # The checkout is the merge of the pull request into its base, so
      # comparing it against the base commit is what the pull request changes.
      - name: Generate the documentation in diff mode
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          composer doc-gen -- --memory-limit=1G --diff="${BASE_SHA}" \
            --base-url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}"

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the preview
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mkdir -p "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
          rsync -a --checksum --delete ../build/docs/ "pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"
          # Jekyll is disabled for the whole site from its root, which the
          # preview may reach before the site itself has been published.
          touch .nojekyll

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this preview."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: preview pull request #${PR_NUMBER} at ${HEAD_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Comment the preview link on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          preview_url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"

          gh pr comment "${PR_NUMBER}" --edit-last --create-if-none --body \
          "**Documentation preview:** ${preview_url}

          Generated in diff mode against \`${BASE_REF}\`, so every page marks what this pull
          request adds, removes, and changes; the display-mode switch next to the theme
          toggle shows the plain documentation, the marked documentation, or the changes
          alone.

          Updated for ${HEAD_SHA}. The preview is removed when this pull request is closed."

  cleanup:
    name: Remove the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action == 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}

      - name: Remove the preview
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          rm -rf "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch carries no preview of this pull request."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: remove the preview of pull request #${PR_NUMBER}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Note the removal on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          gh pr comment "${PR_NUMBER}" --edit-last --body \
            'The documentation preview of this pull request has been removed.' \
            || echo 'This pull request has no preview comment.'

git commit -q -F - <<'MSG'
Adopt k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit and rework the design around its contracts

Brings in the toolkit as a whole rather than its PHPStan rules alone, and
changes the code the gates report on instead of silencing the reports.

Tooling

- PHPStan at max with checked exceptions and the AI error formatter, strict
  PHPUnit with the AI test reporter, Doctest, LocGuard, TreeGuard, ScopeGuard,
  Deptrac, PHPCompatibility with an 8.1 floor, Infection, DocGen, and a CI
  workflow that runs each gate as a named step across PHP 8.1 to 8.5.
- Dependencies are pinned per PHP minor in composer.lock.php-8.x, because the
  dev toolchain genuinely resolves differently across them; the working lock
  file is generated from the matching one.
- Documentation is published from main and previewed per pull request in diff
  mode (.github/workflows/docs.yaml, docs-preview.yaml).

Design

- Direction is one closed enum shared by the CLI option, the configuration,
  the traversal and the edge kinds, and EdgeKind::direction() replaces a
  partial invert() that threw for combinations it did not recognise.
- QualifiedName owns how a PHP name is split and what makes one admissible;
  the IdentifierAssert trait and six copies of the same private helper pair
  are gone, and a namespace with an empty, leading or trailing segment is no
  longer accepted.
- AuthoredEdge replaces EdgeTrait: endpoints are private and set through a
  protected constructor, so no edge kind can be written that forgets one.
- RawConfig reads untrusted configuration once, so Config::fromArray states
  the shape rather than casting per source, and a Config that names the debug
  analyzer now carries its settings by construction.
- The debug analyzer's providers became generators returning a typed
  GeneratedGraph, and TreeCursor owns the per-report state TreeReporter used
  to keep in properties.

Defects this found

- An interface extending an interface built a class node for its parent,
  violating the edge's own precondition; the failure was swallowed and the
  whole file's relations were lost, which is why peq never recorded its own
  InverseEdge extends Edge.
- Graph::merge() threw when two graphs shared a concrete node, ConfigLoader
  dropped a whole group when a later source mentioned one of its settings,
  an unqualified function call inside a namespace never joined its
  declaration, and BuiltinNodeId lacked the empty-namespace guard.

Tests

- Every test declares the units it covers and uses, so the strict coverage
  metadata is real and the mutation run sees the whole executed surface:
  1560 mutants where it used to see 1017. The ratchet is set to that
  measurement, one point under the 70.0% killed outright.
- Reflection agreement moved out of the self-analysis test, which required
  peq's own source to contain every relation kind, into a check that reads
  both peq and the sample sources.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

## What this does

Adopts `k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit` as a whole — not the PHPStan rules alone — and changes the code the gates report on rather than silencing the reports.

## Tooling

| Component | Where |
|---|---|
| PHPStan (max, checked exceptions, AI error formatter) | `phpstan.neon.dist`, `phpstan-stubs/` |
| PHPUnit (strict, AI test reporter) + ParaTest | `phpunit.xml.dist` |
| Doctest (runnable `@example` blocks) | `composer doctest`, 19 examples |
| LocGuard / TreeGuard / ScopeGuard | `loc.yaml`, `tree.yaml`, `scope.yaml` |
| Deptrac (10 layers) | `deptrac.yaml` |
| PHPCompatibility (8.1 floor) | `phpcs.xml.dist` |
| Infection | `infection.json5` |
| DocGen | `composer doc-gen`, published from `main`, previewed per PR |
| GitHub Actions | `.github/workflows/ci.yaml`, `docs.yaml`, `docs-preview.yaml` |

Dependencies are pinned per PHP minor in `composer.lock.php-8.x`, because the dev toolchain genuinely resolves differently across 8.1–8.5 (PHPUnit 10.5/11.5/12.5, Infection 0.29/0.32/0.35); the working lock file is generated from the matching one.

## Design

- **`Direction`** — one closed enum shared by the CLI option, the configuration, the traversal and the edge kinds. `EdgeKind::direction()` replaces an `invert()` that was partial and threw for combinations it did not recognise.
- **`QualifiedName`** — owns how a PHP name is split and what makes one admissible. The `IdentifierAssert` trait and six copies of the same private helper pair are gone, and a namespace with an empty, leading or trailing segment is no longer accepted.
- **`AuthoredEdge`** — replaces `EdgeTrait`. Endpoints are private and set through a protected constructor, so no edge kind can be written that forgets one.
- **`RawConfig`** — reads untrusted configuration once, so `Config::fromArray()` states the shape instead of casting per source. A `Config` naming the debug analyzer now carries its settings by construction, which used to be a runtime exception.
- **Debug analyzer** — providers became generators returning a typed `GeneratedGraph`; **`TreeCursor`** owns the per-report state `TreeReporter` used to keep in properties.

## Defects this surfaced

- `interface B extends A` built a **class** node for the parent, violating the edge's own precondition — and the failure was swallowed, so the whole file's relations were lost. peq never recorded its own `InverseEdge extends Edge`.
- `Graph::merge()` threw when two graphs shared a concrete node.
- `ConfigLoader` dropped a whole group when a later source mentioned one of its settings (`--debug-seed` alone discarded a YAML `debug.depth`).
- An unqualified function call inside a namespace never joined its declaration.
- `BuiltinNodeId` lacked the empty-namespace guard every other identifier has.
- `Graph` had no test for a placeholder being replaced (its edges were wiped), for the stand-in on the *source* endpoint, or for edges differing only in from/to/kind.

## Tests

- Every test declares the units it covers and uses, so `beStrictAboutCoverageMetadata` is real: **0 warnings, 0 risky** under coverage, and CI no longer passes `--do-not-fail-on-risky`.
- That grew the mutation surface from 1017 to **1560 mutants**; 1092 are killed outright (70.0%), and the ratchet sits a point under at 69. The rationale is written into `infection.json5` — worth a look, since the file asks for a human to sanction a lowered threshold.
- Reflection agreement moved out of the self-analysis test, which required peq's own source to contain every relation kind, into `ReflectionAgreementTest` reading peq **and** the sample sources.

## Verified

`composer lint` exits 0 (php-cs-fixer, PHPStan max, PHPCompatibility, LocGuard, TreeGuard, ScopeGuard, Deptrac: 0 violations) · 1303 tests green single-process and under ParaTest · 19 doctests · Infection gate green · 416 doc pages · PHAR builds · CLI verified for both analyzers, `-L` and `--direction=used-by`. PHP 8.1 and 8.2 are verified by CI only.

## Before merging

1. **Create the documentation branch**, or the Docs Preview job fails on this PR:
   ```bash
   git switch --orphan gh-pages
   git commit --allow-empty -m 'docs: create the documentation branch'
   git push -u origin gh-pages
   git switch main
   ```
   Then set Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Source to "Deploy from a branch", branch `gh-pages`, folder `/ (root)`.
2. `git rm --cached composer.lock` — it is gitignored now (pinned per PHP minor) but still tracked.
3. `AGENTS.md` needs a human update: the config layer order is documented as `Default → Env → YAML → CLI` while the code does `Default → YAML → Env → CLI`, the build commands list scripts that no longer exist, and it predates `Direction`, `QualifiedName`, `AuthoredEdge`, the `@visibility` policy and the coverage-metadata rule.

**できたこと**

doc-gen の CI を2本追加しました。ツールキットのテンプレートをこのリポジトリに合わせて調整済みです（`actionlint` は3ファイルとも 0 で通過）。

- `.github/workflows/docs.yaml` — `main` への push と手動実行で生成し、`gh-pages` のルートに同期（`pr/` と `CNAME` は保持）
- `.github/workflows/docs-preview.yaml` — PR で base コミットとの diff モードで生成し、`pr/<番号>/` に公開してリンクをコメント、クローズ時に削除

このリポジトリ向けの調整点は3つです。`composer.lock` は gitignore 済みなので `cp composer.lock.php-8.4 composer.lock` を挟み、キャッシュキーも追跡されている `composer.lock.php-8.4` から取ります。`doc-gen` スクリプトが `--coverage` を要求するため（未生成だと exit 2 で落ちます）、プレビュー側もテンプレートの `coverage: none` ではなく pcov でカバレッジを生成しています — 公開サイトと同じテスト参照リンクが付き、doc-gen のオプションを2箇所に書き分けずに済むためです。ローカルで CI と同じ手順（カバレッジ → `composer doc-gen`）を実行して 416 ページの生成を確認しました。

コミットは `toolkit/php-ai-toolkit-adoption` ブランチに `99a1cca` として作成済み、作業ツリーはクリーンです。PR 本文は `/tmp/peq-pr-body.md` に用意しました。

**認証が通ったら**

```bash
git push -u origin toolkit/php-ai-toolkit-adoption
gh pr create --base main --title 'Adopt k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit and rework the design around its contracts' --body-file /tmp/peq-pr-body.md
```

**2点、判断をお願いしたいこと**

このブランチには push 前のローカルコミット `fa72169`「enable entrie」（`.codex/`, `.cursor/`, `.entire/`, `.gemini/` のフック設定）も含まれています。私の変更と無関係なので、PR に混ぜたくなければ外します（作業ツリーからそれらのファイルが一時的に消えるため、勝手にはやりませんでした）。

それと `gh-pages` ブランチの作成が先です。無いと **この PR で Docs Preview ジョブが失敗します**（`Check out the documentation branch` ステップ）。手順は PR 本文にも入れてあります:

```bash
git switch --orphan gh-pages
git commit --allow-empty -m 'docs: create the documentation branch'
git push -u origin gh-pages
git switch main
```

その後 Settings → Pages → Source を "Deploy from a branch"、`gh-pages` / `(root)` に設定してください。

なお `git rm --cached composer.lock` は今回も権限で拒否されたため、代わりに `composer update --lock` で追跡中の `composer.lock` を composer.json と整合する状態に更新しました（パッケージのバージョン差分はゼロ）。untrack 自体は引き続きお手元での実行が必要です。
